description: Benchy default (user's choice 2026-10-14): band lift v2 plus a local pit-free tilt field (lip rotation, CHANGELOG 2026-10-14). Within 8 mm of the pits over the bulwark lips the rotation field is changed (adjoint of the pit depth, outside held) until the lips print from the deck without lifting; the band lift then lifts 0 vertices. No islands; the rim edge is clean; a patch of closed rings on the hull side 3-8 mm above the rim; hull layer_turns 413. The band-lift-only version is params/benchy upsidedown tilted (band lift v2).json.
